arguments.text: 10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m out-and-back. Pacer sets effort from the pod reserve (cp_shaft 159 W, 15.9 kJ, may be 10-25 pct off). My jobs: (1) check pod gain stays honest: compare pod power, boat-model power, GPS speed, heart rate and stroke rate across legs in the SAME direction (measure/legs); a pod that drifts shows pod power up but HR/rate/speed flat -> set pod_gain. (2) weed/drag: share of pod power reaching boat falls in both directions, clear_rudder fixes it. (3) radio messages: course changes -> set_race_distance + tell. (4) watch HR vs pod reserve to judge if CP is off. Keep cues few; let pacer set effort.

arguments.text: 10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m out-and-back. Pacer sets effort from the pod reserve (cp_shaft 159 W; my estimate 165, range 157-172). Pacer does re-fire ease (111 s, 545 s). Paddler likes ~180 W and blew the reserve to ~9 pct by 8 min; my 300 s piece at -12 pct (480-795 s) held them at CP. Jobs: (1) pod gain honest: compare pod power, boat power, GPS speed, HR, rate across legs in the same direction; baseline share 0.676, current 0.215 m/s (push_local about +0.22 north/out, -0.24 south/back). (2) weed/drag: share falls in BOTH directions -> clear_rudder. (3) radio: course changes -> set_race_distance + tell. (4) Finish: pacer only pushes if pod reserve >40 pct at 800 m to go; if lower but HR says CP is above 159, consider a final piece in the last ~3 min. Keep cues few.

arguments.text: 10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m out(north)-and-back(south). Pacer reads pod reserve with cp_shaft 159 W (reads 0 since ~870 s). My CP estimate ~165 W (HR flat at 164 W, paddler held 175 W 5 min after pod showed 0 with no blow-up); true reserve near empty, HR ~187 near ceiling. Paddler drifts to 175-180 W if left alone: I hold them near 162-165 W with pieces (keep doing this until the finish piece). WIND from the north 8-12 kn filled in at ~1375 s: back(south) legs got ~+0.2 m/s faster, out(north) legs will be slower; the fitted push_along lags, so boat-derived speed/power, fade and my drag_or_pod watch will read FALSE drag on out legs. Weed check now: compare same-direction legs AFTER the wind change only, or use clear_rudder test if a drop happens mid-leg with steady wind. Weed caught at turn ~830 s cleared at 1013 s. Finish: pacer will not push (pod reserve 0). Plan a final piece of about +8 to +10 pct for the last ~500 m if HR / effort allow.
